data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 深夜阳台的晚风依偎
data.description: 宿舍高层阳台晚风习习，远方校园路灯如繁星闪耀。套着黑色大号卫衣的惠把脸颊贴在你的胸膛上，听着沉稳的心跳。无需多言的静谧中，少女嘴角扬起全心信赖的安心微笑。
data.location: private high-rise student dorm balcony overlooking illuminated night campus
data.action: standing on dorm balcony in the cool night breeze, wrapped under partner arm, leaning head against his chest watching distant campus lights
data.lighting: cool moonlight blended with warm ambient room spill
data.mood: absolute psychological security, deep unshakeable trust, calm night tenderness
data.promptProse: Leaning head against partner chest on a cool night balcony, Kei Karuizawa smiles with deep unshakeable trust overlooking campus lights.
data.animaCaption: Kei Karuizawa cuddling securely on a moonlit dorm balcony at night.
